sequenceDiagram
participant Caller
participant Handler
participant Verifier
participant Policy
participant Service
participant Repo
Caller ->> Handler: bearer request
Handler ->> Verifier: validate token
Verifier -->> Handler: result
Handler ->> Policy: check document read
alt denied
Policy -->> Handler: denied
Handler -->> Caller: 403
else allowed
Policy -->> Handler: allowed
Handler ->> Service: read document
Service ->> Repo: transactional read
Repo -->> Service: document
Service -->> Handler: document
Handler -->> Caller: response
end

flowchart LR
subgraph Tx[DB transaction]
Order[Insert order] --> Outbox[Insert outbox]
end
Outbox --> Relay[Relay poll]
Relay --> Broker[Publish]
Broker -.-> Consumer[Consume]
Consumer --> Idempotency[(Idempotency table)]
Idempotency --> Shipment[Apply shipment]
Relay -.->|publish retry| Relay

sequenceDiagram
participant Client
participant Checkout
participant Inventory
participant Payment
Client ->> Checkout: checkout
Checkout ->> Inventory: reserve
Inventory -->> Checkout: result
Checkout ->> Payment: authorize
alt payment failed
Payment -->> Checkout: failed
Checkout ->> Inventory: release
Checkout -->> Client: failure
else payment accepted
Payment -->> Checkout: accepted
Checkout ->> Checkout: persist
Checkout -->> Client: success
end

flowchart TD
Receive[Receive event] --> Validate{Valid?}
Validate -.->|no| Reject[Reject + observe]
Validate -->|yes| Commit[DB commit]
Commit -->|success| Ack[ACK]
Commit -.->|transient under 3| Backoff[Exponential backoff]
Backoff --> Commit
Commit -.->|last failure| DLQ[Publish DLQ]
DLQ -->|published| Ack

flowchart TD
API[API] --> Cache[(Cache)]
Cache --> Hit{Hit?}
Hit -->|yes| Cached[Return cached profile]
Hit -.->|no| DB[(Canonical DB)]
DB --> Populate[Store TTL copy]
Populate --> Result[Return DB profile]

sequenceDiagram
participant Runner
participant User
participant Orders
participant Invoice
Runner ->> User: await loadUser
User -->> Runner: done
Runner ->> Orders: await loadOrders
Orders -->> Runner: done
Runner ->> Invoice: await loadInvoice
Invoice -->> Runner: done

flowchart TD
Check{activateFeature?}
Check -->|true| Render[Call renderNewUI]
Check -.->|false| Skip[Skip call]

participant Worker
participant DB

activate Worker

deactivate Worker

flowchart TD
Receive[Receive batch] --> Duplicate{Message ID seen?}
Duplicate -.->|yes| Skip[Skip duplicate]
Duplicate -->|no| Sort[Sort by occurred at]
Sort --> Apply[Apply in order]
Apply --> Late[Late event also applied]
